六级大纲词汇 · 18英文原文

The Carriage Below the Washout

冲毁路段下方的车厢 · 578 词 · 6 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A locomotive was bringing a school contingent down from a mountain plateau when an alarm sounded. A patrol reported that a stream had begun to overflow. A fallen trunk lay across the rails, its branches abreast of a low signal. The driver stopped before it could derail the train at the junction. A report of a possible derailment reached the depot nonetheless. Arun, the conductor, heard a child groan in the last carriage. One jolt had sent a heavy bag tumbling from the rack.

2The child could walk, but another surge might wreak havoc and rip up the track. Arun asked the passengers to stay seated. Through a window he could see a smaller embankment beyond the stream. Its top led to a disused station. A worker waved a red cloth to designate a safe path. The erection of a timber shelter had given the station a new silhouette, but the rain hid it. The usual road lay beneath water. A slide had exposed a bleached animal skull on the slope. A convoy from the main depot would have to find another approach. Arun gave the controller the carriage number and a clear landmark.

3A parent wanted the children to scramble down the nearest bank. A stray tree trunk rolled in a zigzag across it. Anyone who went astray would be out of sight. Arun checked the slope first. The recent rain had begun to erode the soil. A trek along the rails offered firmer ground, though one stream crossed the route. The parent said the last time she had seen water that high, a tornado had swept through the valley. Arun did not try to foretell how the storm would move. Could everyone reach the old station before the next surge? That was his immediate concern.

4A worker began to manoeuvre a narrow maintenance trolley toward the carriage. Its wheels could glide over a short stretch of rail but not across the washout. Arun asked him to leave it at the stream and use its platform as a bridge. A second worker climbed toward the station and used an oar from a stranded boat to test the soil. He found a strip where they could tread without sinking. The children crossed in pairs. When one stopped, Arun called her name and waited until she was poised to take the next step.

5At the station a lamp began to flicker. For a moment its buzz rose over the water. A technician had placed it there to guide rescuers, but its battery was failing. Arun asked two children to use bright cloth instead. A furious burst of rain made them retreat under the roof. The wind threatened to paralyze the rescue efforts. The valley's usual tranquility vanished beneath a long howl. When the clouds began to disperse, a second train stopped below the washout. Its driver gave a salute from the window and backed up to an intact section of platform.

6Back at the depot, the controller compared the manifest with Arun's account. Everyone had reached safety. The flood report documented the magnitude of the devastation and marked the route the children had taken. The next school group asked why the old station appeared in bold on a new map. Arun told them about a lamp that failed before a train came. He asked them to locate the station themselves. Once they could see it on the map, the route through the valley was no longer just one line.

六级大纲词汇 · 18中文译文

冲毁路段下方的车厢

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一台机车正载着一群学生从高原下山，警报突然响了起来。巡查人员报告，一条小河已经漫过河岸。一根倒下的树干横在铁轨上，树枝伸到一盏低矮信号灯旁。司机及时停车，没让列车在岔道口脱轨。调度站仍收到了可能发生脱轨的报告。列车员阿伦听见最后一节车厢有孩子呻吟。停车那一震，把一个沉重的包从行李架上甩了下来。

2孩子还能走路，但洪水再涨一波，可能冲毁铁轨。阿伦请乘客坐好。他透过车窗，看见水对面有一道较低的路堤，堤顶通往一座废弃车站。一名工人挥着红布，标出安全的路线。新搭的木棚改变了车站的轮廓，可雨幕挡住了视线。常走的路已经淹没，塌下去的坡面露出一块白色的动物头骨。从总站来的车队只好另找路。阿伦向调度员报了车厢编号和一个明显的地标。

3一位家长想让孩子们从最近的坡跑下去。一根被水冲来的树干弯弯曲曲地滚过坡面，走错路的人很快就会从视线里消失。阿伦先察看了斜坡。连日的雨已经开始冲刷土壤。沿铁路走远些，地面更结实，不过有一处水流横在路上。那位家长说，上次水这么高时，有一场龙卷风经过山谷。阿伦没去猜风暴接下来怎么走。他更想弄清眼前的事，下一波水到来前，能不能把所有人带到旧车站。

4一名工人把一辆窄窄的检修车推向车厢。它能沿短短一截铁轨滑行，却过不了冲毁的路段。阿伦请他把车放到水边，用车上的平台搭座临时桥。另一名工人爬向车站，拿一把搁浅小船的桨试探土面，找到一条踩上去不会下陷的路。孩子们两人一组过水。有个女孩停了下来，阿伦叫了她一声，等她站稳，做好了迈下一步的准备。

5车站的灯开始闪烁。那一刻，嗡嗡声盖过了水声。技术员把灯放在那里，原本是给救援人员指路的，但电池快没电了。阿伦请两个孩子换用鲜艳的布。暴雨劈头盖脸落下，他们只好退进棚里。大风可能让救援陷入停顿。山谷平日的宁静被一声长长的呼啸吞没。云散开时，第二列车停在冲毁路段下方。司机从车窗向大家致意，再把车倒到完好的站台旁。

6回到总站，调度员拿乘车名单和阿伦的记录一一比对，确认人人平安。洪灾报告记下了破坏的程度，也标出孩子们走过的路线。下一批学生问，为什么新地图把旧车站印成粗体。阿伦给他们讲了那盏在救援列车到来前失灵的灯，又请他们自己在图上找车站。等他们认出那个地方，穿过山谷的路线就不再只是纸上的一条线了。
